titleEn: How Long Does a Condo Renovation Take in Metro Vancouver? Real 2026 Timelines
titleZh: Condo 裝修要多久？大溫哥華 2026 實際工期指南
contentEn:
Metro Vancouver condo renovations run 6–16 weeks from permit approval to final walk-through, with the widest variation coming from strata council approval timelines. A standard kitchen refresh takes 6–8 weeks. A full kitchen and bathroom gut runs 10–14 weeks. Whole-unit renovations span 12–16 weeks. The single biggest variable in a condo project is not construction — it is getting strata sign-off before a building permit can even be applied for.

Why Condo Renovations Take Longer Than Houses

Every condo renovation in Metro Vancouver requires two parallel approval streams before any work begins. The strata council must review and approve the scope of work, and the municipality must issue a building permit. Neither can be skipped, and neither is fast. Strata approval alone can take 2–6 weeks depending on the complexity of the application and the council's meeting schedule. Municipal permits for plumbing and electrical changes add another 2–4 weeks on top of that. In a house renovation, these steps either do not exist or run concurrently with other prep work — in a condo, they run first.

Kitchen Renovation Timeline in a Metro Vancouver Condo

A standard kitchen renovation in a condo — new cabinets, countertop, backsplash, and updated lighting on an existing layout — takes 6–8 weeks from permit issuance to completion. A full gut renovation with an island addition or open-concept wall removal stretches to 10–14 weeks, because structural changes require an engineer's letter and the city's structural permit review adds 1–2 weeks. The city permit for a condo kitchen with electrical changes typically processes in 2–3 weeks. Strata review for cabinet replacement alone is straightforward; anything involving wall demolition requires a full submission package including contractor credentials, $5M CGL insurance, and a damage deposit.

Bathroom Renovation Timeline in a Metro Vancouver Condo

A standard condo bathroom renovation — new tile, vanity, toilet, and fixtures — runs 4–6 weeks from permit issuance. An ensuite with a curbless walk-in shower, heated floors, and frameless glass extends to 6–9 weeks, primarily because glass fabrication has a 2–3 week lead time. Burnaby, Coquitlam, and New Westminster all impose strata-mandated construction hours for condos — typically 9am–5pm weekdays — which slightly extends the overall schedule compared to a freehold project where work can run 7am–6pm.

Strata Approval: The Hidden Timeline Variable

Strata approval is the step most first-time condo renovators underestimate. A complete submission package must include the renovation application, a detailed scope description, a $5M CGL insurance certificate, WCB confirmation, and a damage deposit typically ranging from $500–$2,000. Most Metro Vancouver stratas return approvals within 2–4 weeks of receiving a complete package. Richmond stratas in particular have a strong track record of returning decisions in 2–4 weeks when the package is complete. Incomplete packages are returned for revision, which resets the clock. A Reno Stars project manager prepares and submits the complete package at permit stage, so the strata timeline starts counting from submission, not from the first inquiry.

How Your Neighbourhood Affects the Condo Renovation Timeline

Not all Metro Vancouver cities process condo renovation permits at the same speed. Burnaby processes standard residential permits in 1–2 weeks. Coquitlam and Port Coquitlam run 2–3 weeks for standard permits. Richmond typically runs 2–4 weeks. West Vancouver's District processes permits in 4–8 weeks — the longest in Metro Vancouver — and projects in the British Properties may also require geotechnical assessment and covenant review, adding 4–6 weeks before a permit application can even be submitted. If your condo is in West Vancouver, budget an additional 6–10 weeks of pre-construction time beyond what a comparable project in Burnaby or Coquitlam would require.

Frequently Asked Questions: Condo Renovation Timelines in Metro Vancouver

What is the fastest condo renovation scope in Metro Vancouver?

A cosmetic refresh — new flooring, paint, and updated fixtures — requires no structural permit and no strata approval in most buildings, provided no plumbing or electrical work is involved. Cosmetic-only renovations can begin within 1–2 weeks of contract signing. Any work involving the plumbing lines, electrical circuits, or walls requires the full strata and permit process regardless of scope.

Does strata approval run before or after the building permit?

In most Metro Vancouver condos, strata approval must be obtained before the building permit application is submitted to the city. Some buildings have pre-approved renovation lists for standard scopes — cabinet replacement, countertop swaps, flooring — that can skip the strata meeting and proceed directly to permit. Reno Stars confirms the building's renovation guidelines during the initial site visit.

Can Reno Stars manage strata communication in languages other than English?

Yes. The Reno Stars team includes Mandarin and Cantonese speakers who handle strata correspondence directly with property managers and council representatives. For Richmond condos in particular — where a large share of owners are Mandarin or Cantonese speakers — bilingual coordination significantly reduces miscommunication that can delay approvals.

What happens if strata denies the renovation application?

Strata councils can only deny based on legitimate building bylaws or the Strata Property Act. Applications that are denied can be resubmitted with additional documentation, or in some cases the dispute can be referred to the BC Civil Resolution Tribunal. Reno Stars has never had a complete application denied outright; if a strata raises a concern, the project manager addresses it with the required documentation before resubmission.

contentZh:
大溫哥華Condo裝修從許可批准到最終驗收通常需要6至16週，其中差異最大的因素並非施工本身，而是來自共管委員會的審批時間。標準廚房翻新需6至8週。廚房與浴室全面翻新則需10至14週。全屋翻新工程則介於12至16週。在Condo裝修項目中，最大變數不是工程本身，而是必須先獲得共管委員會批准，才能遞交建築許可申請。

為什麼Condo裝修比獨立屋裝修更耗時

大溫哥華每一個Condo裝修項目都需要在施工前完成兩條平行的審批流程：共管委員會必須審查並批准工程範圍，同時市政府必須發放建築許可。這兩步驟都無法跳過，且兩者都非快速流程。僅共管委員會批准就需要2至6週，具體時間取決於申請複雜程度及委員會的會議安排。市政許可則需再增加2至4週。獨立屋裝修通常不需要這些流程，或可與其他準備工作同時進行；但在Condo中，這些步驟必須優先完成。

大溫哥華Condo廚房翻新工期

在Condo中進行標準廚房翻新——更換櫥櫃、檯面、瓷磚背板及更新照明，且不改變既有佈局——從許可發放到完工通常需要6至8週。若採用全面翻新，包括增加中島或拆除隔斷牆，則延長至10至14週，因為結構變動需要工程師簽章，且市政府的結構許可審查會額外增加1至2週。涉及電路改動的Condo廚房許可通常需要2至3週處理時間。僅更換櫥櫃的審批流程較簡單；任何涉及牆體拆改的工程則需提交完整文件包，包括承包商資質、500萬責任險證書及裝修押金。

大溫哥華Condo浴室翻新工期

標準Condo浴室翻新——新瓷磚、洗手台、馬桶及五金——從許可發放到完工通常需要4至6週。配有步入式淋浴間、地暖及無框玻璃的套房浴室則延長至6至9週，主要因為玻璃加工需要2至3週交貨期。Burnaby、Coquitlam及New Westminster均對Condo實施強制施工時段限制，通常為工作日上午9時至下午5時，這與獨立屋項目可從上午7時至下午6時施工相比，會稍微延長整體工期。

共管委員會審批：隱藏的工期變數

共管委員會審批是多數首次進行Condo裝修的業主最容易低估的環節。完整申請文件包必須包含裝修申請表、詳細工程範圍說明、500萬責任險證書、WCB確認函，以及通常在500至2000加元之間的裝修押金。大溫哥華多數共管委員會在收到完整文件包後2至4週內給出審批結果。Richmond的共管委員會在文件完整的情況下有良好及時審批記錄。文件不完整時會被退回修改，並重新計算審批時間。Reno Stars的項目經理會在許可階段準備並提交完整文件包，確保共管委員會的時間從提交日開始計算，而非從首次諮詢日計算。

城市對Condo裝修工期的影响

並非大溫哥華所有城市的Condo裝修許可辦理速度都相同。Burnaby標準住宅許可通常1至2週處理完畢。Coquitlam及Port Coquitlam為2至3週。Richmond通常2至4週。West Vancouver區政府處理許可時間最長，達4至8週，且British Properties的項目可能還需要地質技術評估及契約審查，在許可申請遞交前就需額外增加4至6週。若您的Condo位於West Vancouver，需比位於Burnaby或Coquitlam的類似項目多預留6至10週的施工前期準備時間。

常見問題：大溫哥華Condo裝修工期

大溫哥華最快的Condo裝修項目是什麼？

純美觀翻新——更換地板、牆面漆及更新五金——不需要結構許可，且在大多數建築中不需要共管委員會批准，前提是不涉及水管或電路工程。純美觀翻新可在合約簽署後1至2週內開工。任何涉及水管管線、電路或牆體的工程，無論規模大小，都需要完整的共管委員會及許可流程。

共管委員會審批是在建築許可之前還是之後進行？

在大多數大溫哥華Condo中，共管委員會批准必須在建築許可申請遞交之前完成。部分樓盤對標準裝修範圍（如櫥櫃更換、檯面更換、地板）設有預先批准清單，可跳過共管委員會會議直接進入許可階段。Reno Stars會在首次現場勘察時確認該樓盤的裝修指南。

Reno Stars能否以英語以外的語言處理共管委員會溝通？

可以。Reno Stars團隊包含國語及粵語溝通人員，直接與物業管理公司及委員會代表進行共管委員會相關溝通。特別是Richmond的Condo，許多業主以國語或粵語為母語，雙語協調能大幅減少可能導致審批延遲的溝通障礙。

如果共管委員會拒絕裝修申請怎麼辦？

共管委員會只能根據合法的大廈管理條例或《卑詩省共管財產法》合理拒絕申請。被拒絕的申請可以補充文件後重新提交，或在部分情況下向卑詩省民事調解法庭提請爭議。Reno Stars從未遇到完整申請被直接拒絕的情況；若委員會提出疑慮，項目經理會在重新提交前以所需文件解決問題。
